title.description: Title of the TheHive alert to match on (exact match). With the TA-thehive-cortex alert action and the default '<inheritance>' title, this is the Splunk saved search name. Required when discover is false.

source.description: Source of the TheHive alert to match on (exact match), e.g. 'splunk'

correlation.description: How an alert is tied to the detonation. 'uuid' looks for the detonation UUID in observables and the description. 'host' is for telemetry that cannot carry the UUID (e.g. flightsim network traffic): it matches alerts created after the run started with an observable equal to one of the addresses in THEHIVE_DETONATION_HOSTS. Requires title.

observableField.description: Only look for the detonation UUID in observables tagged 'field:<observableField>', the tag TA-thehive-cortex sets from the Splunk field name. If omitted, every observable and the alert description are searched.
